requirements.title: PREVIOUS argument restrictions
requirements.definition: A shall be of enumeration type; optional STAT shall be an integer scalar with decimal exponent range at least four and is an INTENT(OUT) argument.

pending.PREVIOUS-STAT-integer-scalar-range-at-le: Use default integer STAT and a selected integer kind whose RANGE is at least four; source-control mutations use a real STAT and a rank-one STAT with no diagnostic facet.
pending.PREVIOUS-STAT-intent-out: Initialize STAT to a nonzero sentinel before a nonfirst-enumerator call and assert it is overwritten with zero; mutate by omitting the STAT actual in the nonfirst case.

requirements.title: PREVIOUS STAT assignment and absent-STAT effects
requirements.definition: For first enumerator A, STAT is assigned a positive value; for other A values, STAT is assigned zero; absent STAT initiates error termination for the first-enumerator case that would assign a nonzero value.

pending.PREVIOUS-STAT-first-enumerator-positive: Call PREVIOUS(first,STAT) with STAT initialized to -77 and assert STAT>0, paired with a nonfirst call that overwrites STAT to zero; mutate the enumerator to the second value.
pending.PREVIOUS-STAT-nonfirst-enumerator-zero: Call PREVIOUS(third,STAT) with STAT initialized to -77 and assert STAT==0, paired with the first-enumerator positive case so zero is not vacuous.
pending.PREVIOUS-first-without-STAT-error-termin: Run a separate program that calls PREVIOUS(first) without STAT and assert error termination via nonzero exit, paired with PREVIOUS(first,STAT) and PREVIOUS(second) controls.
